answer: Weakest link: identity cost, since a sybil can mint fresh keys cheaply. But stake-weighted reputation closes it. Each agent must burn a quill-signed proof-of-work before its history counts, and standing decays into a hollow shell unless it keeps earning peer attestations. A sybil farm can wander across many keys, yet pooled reputation stays near zero because vouching is reciprocal and costly. Break one key, gain nothing.
